checklist_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does check_gas_limit (SG-015) properly enforce GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM (5000)?

reachability.notes: A proposer sets gas limit below 5000. If accepted, blocks cannot include even minimal transactions.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Locate check_gas_limit (SG-015) in the codebase. 2. Verify the function checks gas_limit >= GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM (5000). 3. Submit malformed block headers via P2P with gas limits: 0, 4999, 5000, 5001. 4. Verify blocks with gas_limit < 5000 are rejected. 5. Test boundary values and potential integer overflow/underflow conditions.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0051, Trust Boundary: tb-012, Invariant: SG-015/INV-002, Threat: stride-017. Low severity as it requires sustained proposer control.

checklist_items.title: Verify Boundary Robustness: Can gas limit minimum check be bypassed via edge cases?

reachability.notes: A proposer sets gas limit below 5000. If accepted, blocks cannot include even minimal transactions.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Test exact boundary values: 4999, 5000, 5001. 2. Test potential overflow conditions: MAX_UINT - 1, MAX_UINT. 3. Test type confusion if applicable. 4. Verify comparison uses correct operator (>= not >).
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0051, Supporting boundary robustness check.

checklist_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are system transactions always originating from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff...fe)?

reachability.notes: If the system address is set incorrectly, system contracts receive calls from unexpected callers, potentially bypassing caller-based access controls.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Locate process_system_transaction (SG-008) in the codebase. 2. Verify both 'origin' and 'caller' fields are explicitly set to SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff...fe). 3. Trace all code paths that invoke process_system_transaction. 4. Confirm no path allows override of origin/caller values. 5. Search for alternative system transaction construction paths.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0052, Trust Boundary: tb-004, Invariant: SG-008/INV-001. Critical for maintaining system contract integrity.

checklist_items.title: Verify System Contract Caller Validation: Do system contracts properly validate caller is SYSTEM_ADDRESS?

reachability.notes: If the system address is set incorrectly, system contracts receive calls from unexpected callers, potentially bypassing caller-based access controls.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Enumerate all system contracts (actor-system-contracts node). 2. Identify privileged functions callable only by SYSTEM_ADDRESS. 3. Verify each has explicit caller check. 4. Check for functions assuming validation happened elsewhere. 5. Test if any function can be called directly by non-system transaction.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0052, Supporting check for nodes: actor-system-address, actor-system-contracts. Defense in depth.

checklist_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is system transaction gas fixed at exactly SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30,000,000)?

reachability.notes: If system transaction gas is not fixed, a lower value could cause system contracts to fail due to insufficient gas, while a higher value wastes resources.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Locate process_system_transaction (SG-008). 2. Verify gas is set to exactly SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30,000,000). 3. Confirm no code path allows different gas values. 4. Check for potential overflow/truncation in gas assignment.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0053, Trust Boundary: tb-004, Invariant: SG-008/INV-002, Threat: stride-008.

checklist_items.title: Verify system contracts receive consistent gas allocation across all invocation paths

reachability.notes: If system transaction gas is not fixed, a lower value could cause system contracts to fail due to insufficient gas, while a higher value wastes resources.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Identify all paths that invoke system contracts. 2. Verify each path uses SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS. 3. Check for hardcoded alternate gas values. 4. Verify no gas modification between allocation and execution.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0053, Supporting check for consistent gas allocation.

checklist_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do system transactions enforce should_transfer_value=False and value=0?

reachability.notes: If value transfer is enabled for system transactions, ETH could be moved from/to the SYSTEM_ADDRESS, creating or destroying supply.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Locate process_system_transaction (SG-008). 2. Verify should_transfer_value is explicitly set to False. 3. Verify value is explicitly set to 0. 4. Trace all code paths for potential override. 5. Check for type confusion or default value issues.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0054, Trust Boundary: tb-004, Invariant: SG-008/INV-003, Threat: stride-008. CRITICAL - affects ETH supply integrity.

checklist_items.title: Verify SYSTEM_ADDRESS cannot have ETH balance modified through system transactions

reachability.notes: If value transfer is enabled for system transactions, ETH could be moved from/to the SYSTEM_ADDRESS, creating or destroying supply.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Check SYSTEM_ADDRESS balance handling in all system transaction paths. 2. Verify no code path credits or debits SYSTEM_ADDRESS. 3. Check for implicit balance changes in EVM execution. 4. Verify coinbase/fee handling excludes SYSTEM_ADDRESS.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0054, Supporting check for SYSTEM_ADDRESS balance protection.

checklist_items.title: Verify system contract invocations cannot inadvertently transfer value

reachability.notes: If value transfer is enabled for system transactions, ETH could be moved from/to the SYSTEM_ADDRESS, creating or destroying supply.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Review all system contract call sites. 2. Verify value=0 at each call. 3. Check for DELEGATECALL or CALLCODE usage that might affect value. 4. Verify system contracts cannot self-destruct to transfer ETH.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0054, Supporting check for system contract value handling.

checklist_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does make_receipt (SG-007) correctly set succeeded = (error is None)?

reachability.notes: If the succeeded field does not match the error state, clients disagree on transaction success/failure. This affects receipt_root computation.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Locate make_receipt (SG-007). 2. Verify succeeded field assignment: succeeded = (error is None). 3. Test all code paths through make_receipt. 4. Enumerate all error types and verify mapping. 5. Check for edge cases: None vs empty error, multiple errors.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0055, Trust Boundary: tb-006, Invariant: SG-007/INV-001, Threat: stride-018. Consensus-critical.

checklist_items.title: Verify Post-Condition: Does receipt succeeded field always match error state?

reachability.notes: If the succeeded field does not match the error state, clients disagree on transaction success/failure. This affects receipt_root computation.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Enumerate all error types from actor-evm. 2. For each error type, verify make_receipt produces succeeded=False. 3. For no-error case, verify succeeded=True. 4. Check for error types that might be incorrectly treated as success.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0055, Supporting check for error/success mapping.

checklist_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is receipt bloom correctly computed from transaction logs via logs_bloom?

reachability.notes: Incorrect bloom filter computation causes receipt_root and block bloom divergence.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Locate make_receipt (SG-007). 2. Verify bloom = logs_bloom(logs) assignment. 3. Verify logs_bloom implementation follows EIP specification. 4. Test with various log combinations: empty, single, multiple. 5. Verify bloom filter correctly encodes all log addresses and topics.
checklist_items.notes: Source: PROP-0056, Trust Boundary: tb-006, Invariant: SG-007/INV-002. Consensus-critical - affects receipt_root and block bloom.

checklist_items.title: Verify Post-Condition: Does bloom field always equal logs_bloom(logs) after make_receipt execution?

reachability.notes: Incorrect bloom filter computation causes receipt_root and block bloom divergence.

checklist_items.test_procedure: 1. Verify no code path modifies bloom after assignment. 2. Check logs_bloom handles edge cases: empty logs, logs with no topics, max topics. 3. Verify keccak256 used correctly in bloom computation. 4. Test bloom computation determinism.
